mapper.select: SELECT vdhp.id, vdhp.video_device_id AS videoDeviceId, vd.code AS deviceCode, vd.name AS deviceName, vdhp.bind_time AS bindTime, vdhp.install_longitude AS installLongitude, vdhp.install_latitude AS installLatitude FROM video_device_hazard_point vdhp INNER JOIN video_device vd ON vdhp.video_device_id = vd.id AND vd.del_flag = 0 WHERE vdhp.hazard_point_id = #{hazardPointId} ORDER BY vdhp.bind_time DESC
